newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to issue 33.01 trln yen gov debt via mkt.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to issue 33.01 trln yen gov debt via mkt.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance said on Thursday it plans to issue 33.01 trillion yen in government debt through the market in fiscal 1997/98, starting next April 1.

The MOF will also sell 15.14 trillion yen of government debt directly to public institutions, such as the Trust Fund Bureau of the MOF, the postal savings system at the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry and the Bank of Japan.
The figures mean the total amount of government debt to be issued in the next fiscal year will rise to 48.15 trillion yen, from 47.59 trillion yen in fiscal 1996/97.
All figures for 1996/97 were on the initial request basis, excluding any extra debt issues arising from a possible supplementary budget before the end of the fiscal year.
The MOF also said it plans to issue 30.00 trillion yen worth of government guaranteed bonds for 1997/98.
